pay_detail: You do not get paid. Each project can receive a microgrant of $1,000 to $5,000 to carry it out. The money pays for the project, not a wage to you.
name: Youth Climate Action Fund microgrants
what_you_do: Young residents design a climate project and apply for a $1,000 to $5,000 microgrant to carry it out. City staff help with ideas before you apply.
who_can_apply: Aurora residents ages 15 to 24. The FAQ says at least two young people ages 15 to 24 must propose, design and lead each project. The page lists separate planning sessions. They are for Aurora high school students, college students and nonprofits.
deadline_text: Applications ran August 24 to October 16, 2026. The FAQ page lists an earlier close date, October 5, 2026. The FAQ says the city may get a second round of funding if all projects finish on time. No date for a second round is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application form. Staff office hours are Tuesdays 2 to 4 p.m. (630-256-3416) and Wednesdays 10 a.m. to noon (630-256-3402) during the window. Email youthservdiv@aurora.il.us.
notes: The main page says about 10 to 40 projects will be funded. The FAQ says 10 to 50, from a $50,000 total. Funds go out by November 13, 2026, and projects must be done by April 15, 2027. Co-design sessions were September 8 and 10, 2026, so they have passed. Ages up to 24 are allowed, so high school students compete with older applicants. No new round is posted, so the dates shown are from the 2026 round.
